titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Queen's Praise of Wisdom and Her Departure (ch. 24)
part: ch. 24 — The Queen's Praise of Wisdom and Her Departure
about: The queen gathers her court and tells them why she must go: she loves wisdom more than gold, honey or light, and having heard of Solomon she loves him unseen. Her nobles and servants vow to share her life and death. She sets out with a great caravan, trusting in God (compare 1 Kings 10, Proverbs 8, Wisdom of Solomon 6–7).

sentences.t: ፳፬ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተደለወት ፡ ለሐዊር ።
sentences.l: 24. Where she-made-ready to-go.
sentences.i: Chapter 24: Where She Made Ready to Go
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፬ is 20 + 4 = 24. ኀበ is the conjunction 'where' (as in the headings of ch. 17–19, 23), so 'Where she made ready to go' means the place or occasion of her setting out. ተደለወት is the 3fs perfect of ተደለወ 'be prepared, make ready' (the ተ- Gt stem, here with a reflexive sense); ለሐዊር is ለ- 'to' + the infinitive ሐዊር 'going' (of ሖረ), the usual way to say 'in order to go'.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎሙ ፡ ስምዑ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ እሊአየ ፡ ወአፅምኡኒ ፡ ነገርየ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-them: hear (you) word-my, [ʾəliʾäya?], and-incline-ear-also speech-my;
sentences.i: And she said to them: 'Hear my word, and give ear to my speech;
sentences.n: ወትቤሎሙ 'and she said to them' (ወ- + ትቤ, the 3fs of the irregular verb 'say', + ሎሙ 'to them'). ስምዑ is the 2mp imperative of ሰምዐ 'hear'. ቃልየ 'my word' (ቃል + -የ 'my'). I cannot identify እሊአየ: it sits beside ቃልየ as a doublet and carries the same -የ 'my', so I read it as another word for 'my saying', but I have left it out of the free translation (uncertain). ወአፅምኡኒ: 2mp imperative of አጽመአ 'incline the ear, listen', with ወ- 'and' and the enclitic -ኒ 'also, and'; ነገርየ 'my speech'. The queen's speech to her court begins here and runs to the ፨ after ch. 24's praise of wisdom; its parallel lines in pairs (word // speech) are the usual shape of Semitic exhortation.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አንሰ ፡ እፈቅድ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ ወልብየኒ ፡ ተኀሥሣ ፡ ለአእምሮ ፤
sentences.l: for I-as-for I-desire wisdom, and-heart-my-also it-seeks for-knowledge;
sentences.i: for I, for my part, desire wisdom, and my heart too seeks after knowledge;
sentences.n: እስመ 'for' opens each line of the opening of the speech (flagged here, then nudged). አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + the contrastive -ሰ, which sets her against others). እፈቅድ 'I desire, love' (1cs imperfect of ፈቅደ). ጥበበ is the accusative of ጥበብ 'wisdom'. ወልብየኒ 'and my heart also' (ወ- + ልብ + -የ 'my' + -ኒ 'also'). ተኀሥሣ: I read this as ተኀሥሠ 'seek' with -ኣ 'her', 'it sought her', but the form is not certain (it could also be a Gt of ኀሠሠ 'be sought'); ለአእምሮ 'for knowledge' (ለ- + አእምሮ). The sense 'the heart seeks knowledge' is clear either way.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ተነደፍኩ ፡ በፍቅረ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወተስሕብኩ ፡ በአሕባለ ፡ አእምሮ ፤
sentences.l: for I-was-pierced with-love-of wisdom, and-I-was-drawn with-cords-of knowledge;
sentences.i: for I was pierced by love of wisdom and drawn by the cords of knowledge;
sentences.n: ተነደፍኩ is the 1cs perfect of ተነድፈ, the passive of ነደፈ 'sting, pierce'. በፍቅረ 'with the love of' (በ- 'by, with' + ፍቅር in the construct state, which takes -ε before its dependent noun: ፍቅረ ጥበብ 'love-of wisdom'). ወተስሕብኩ 'and I was drawn' (1cs perfect of ተሰሕበ, the passive of ሰሐበ 'draw, drag'). በአሕባለ 'with the cords of' (አሕባል, plural of ሐብል 'rope'). The pairing 'pierced' and 'drawn with cords' recalls Hosea 11:4, where God draws with 'cords of love'; I note it as an echo, not a quotation.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ እመዝገበ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፤
sentences.l: for it-is-better wisdom than-treasure-of gold and-silver;
sentences.i: for wisdom is better than a treasury of gold and silver;
sentences.n: ትኄይስ 'she is better' (3fs imperfect of ኄየሰ 'be good, better'; ጥበብ is feminine, so the verb takes ት-). እመዝገበ is እም- 'than, from' + መዝገብ 'treasure, store' in the construct state (መዝገበ ወርቅ 'storehouse of gold'). The comparison of wisdom with gold and silver is the stock opening of the wisdom tradition: Proverbs 3:14 and 8:10–11, Wisdom of Solomon 7:8–9. This whole speech is built on it, and the queen is praising what she is about to go and seek in Solomon.

sentences.t: ጥበብሰ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኴሉ ፡ ዘተፈጥረ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: wisdom-as-for she-is-better than all which was-created on earth.
sentences.i: Wisdom is better than all that was created on the earth.
sentences.n: ጥበብሰ with the contrastive -ሰ: 'wisdom, as for her'. እምነ ኴሉ 'than all' (ኴሉ is a variant spelling of ኵሉ). ዘተፈጥረ 'which was created' (ዘ- + 3ms perfect of ተፈጥረ, the passive of ፈጠረ 'create'). ዲበ ምድር 'on the earth' (ዲበ 'upon' + ምድር).

sentences.t: በምንትኬ ፡ ያስተማስልዋ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ ሰማይ ፤
sentences.l: With-what-then they-liken her to-wisdom under heaven?
sentences.i: To what, then, can wisdom be compared under heaven?
sentences.n: A question. በምንትኬ 'with what, then' (በ- + ምንት 'what' + the enclitic -ኬ 'then, indeed'). ያስተማስልዋ 'they liken her' (3mp imperfect of አስተማሰለ 'make like, compare', + -ዋ 'her'); the object is repeated by ለጥበብ 'to wisdom', the same anticipating suffix flagged in ch. 21–23. The subject is impersonal ('one'), so 'can wisdom be compared' is a fair rendering. በታሕተ ሰማይ 'under heaven' (ታሕተ 'beneath').

sentences.t: ትጥዕም ፡ እምነ ፡ መዓር ፡ ወታስተፌሥሕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወታበርህ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወትትፈቀር ፡ እምነ ፡ ዕንቌ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ወታጠልል ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ወታጸግብ ፡ እምነ ፡ መባልዕት ፡ ጥዑማት ፡ ወታከብር ፡ እምነ ፡ አእላፍ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፤
sentences.l: she-is-sweet more-than honey, and-she-gladdens more-than wine, and-she-gives-light more-than sun, and-she-is-loved more-than stone precious, and-she-shelters more-than ointment, and-she-satisfies more-than foods sweet, and-she-honours more-than thousands-of gold and-silver;
sentences.i: She is sweeter than honey, she gladdens more than wine, she gives more light than the sun, she is more loved than a precious stone, she shelters (?) more than oil, she satisfies more than sweet dishes, and she brings more honour than thousands upon thousands of gold and silver;
sentences.n: A list of seven comparisons with እምነ 'than', all verbs 3fs imperfect with ት- because ጥበብ is feminine. ትጥዕም 'she is sweet' (ጠዕመ). ታስተፌሥሕ 'she gladdens' (አስተፈሥሐ, causative). ታበርህ 'she gives light, shines' (አብርሀ). ትትፈቀር 'she is loved' (ተፈቅረ, passive of ፈቅረ). ታጠልል: I take it as the causative of ጠለለ 'give shade, shelter', but 'shelter more than ointment' is a strange pairing and I am not sure of the word (?). ታጸግብ 'she satisfies' (አጸገበ, causative of ጸገበ 'be sated'). ታከብር 'she honours, makes glorious' (አክበረ). መባልዕት ጥዑማት 'sweet dishes' (plural noun + plural adjective). አእላፍ is the plural of አልፍ 'thousand', so 'thousands upon thousands'. The comparison with honey, wine, precious stones, oil and gold is the praise of the Law in Psalm 19:10 and of wisdom in Proverbs 8 and Wisdom of Solomon 7.

sentences.t: መስተፈሥሒት ፡ ለልብ ፡ ወመብርሂት ፡ ለአዕይንት ፡ ወከዋው ፡ ለእግር ፡ ወድርዕ ፡ ለእንግድኣ ፡ ወጌራ ፡ ለርእስ ፡ ወብዝጋና ፡ ለክሳድ ፡ ወመቀነቲ ፡ ለሐቌያት ፡ ወመስምዕ ፡ ለአእዛን ፡ ወመጥበቢ ፡ ለአልባብ ፡ ወትምህርት ፡ ለማእምራን ፡ ወመናዘዚ ፡ ለልቡባን ፡ ወወሃቤ ፡ ክብር ፡ ለኀሣሥያን ።
sentences.l: gladdener for-heart and-illuminator for-eyes and-[käwaw?] for-foot and-armour for-the-stranger and-[gera?] for-head and-necklace(?) for-neck and-girdle for-loins and-hearing for-ears and-teacher-of-wisdom for-hearts and-teaching for-knowers and-comforter for-the-prudent and-giver-of honour to-seekers.
sentences.i: A gladdener of the heart, a light for the eyes, a [käwaw] (?) for the foot, armour for the stranger, a [gera] (?) for the head, a collar (?) for the neck, a girdle for the loins, a hearing for the ears, a teacher of wisdom for the hearts, instruction for the learned, a comforter for the prudent, and a giver of honour to those who seek her.
sentences.n: The list continues as predicate nouns, with no verb: 'she is …'. The -ት agent nouns are feminine to agree with ጥበብ. መስተፈሥሒት 'gladdener' and መብርሂት 'illuminator, giver of light' are መ- agent nouns from the same roots as the verbs of the previous unit. Each ለ- 'for' names who benefits (ለልብ, ለአዕይንት 'for the eyes'), a pattern of body parts and what protects or adorns them. Words I could not settle: ከዋው ለእግር (the sense 'something for the foot' fits, a sandal or support, but the word is unidentified; I leave it bracketed); ጌራ ለርእስ (something for the head, a crown or garland; unidentified); ብዝጋና ለክሳድ ('a collar for the neck', a guess from the parallel); ድርዕ 'armour' (ድርዕ is a coat of mail or shield); ለእንግድኣ 'for the stranger' (አንግዳ, here with the odd ending -ኣ). መቀነቲ 'girdle' for the loins (ሐቌ, plural ሐቌያት). መጥበቢ I read as 'means of wisdom' (from ጠበበ 'be wise'). ማእምራን 'knowers, the learned'; መናዘዚ 'comforter' (from ናዘዘ), ልቡባን 'the prudent'; ወሃቤ ክብር 'giver of honour' (construct chain), ለኀሣሥያን 'to seekers' (ኀሣሢ 'seeker', plural -ያን).

sentences.t: ወመንግሥትኒ ፡ ኢይቀውም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወብዕልኒ ፡ ኢይትዐቀብ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወእግርኒ ፡ ኢይጸንዕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኬደ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወልሳንኒ ፡ ኢይትፈቀር ፡ ዘተናገረ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥበብ ።
sentences.l: and-kingdom-also not-it-stands without wisdom, and-wealth-also not-it-is-guarded without wisdom, and-foot-also not-it-is-firm where it-walked without wisdom, and-tongue-also not-it-is-loved which-spoke without wisdom.
sentences.i: Neither does a kingdom stand without wisdom, nor is wealth kept safe without wisdom, nor is the foot made firm where it walks without wisdom, nor is the tongue that speaks loved without wisdom.
sentences.n: Four parallel clauses, each ወX-ኒ ኢ-verb ዘእንበለ ጥበብ. The -ኒ attached to the subject ('kingdom-also') carries 'also, even' and with ኢ- gives 'neither … nor'. ዘእንበለ 'without' (here with a plain noun, ዘእንበለ ጥበብ 'without wisdom'); flagged once, then nudged. ኢይቀውም 'it does not stand' (ቀወመ); ኢይትዐቀብ 'is not guarded' (ተዐቅበ, passive of ዐቀበ); ኢይጸንዕ 'is not firm, strong' (ጸንዐ); ኀበ ኬደ 'where it walked' (ኬደ 3ms perfect of ከይደ 'tread, walk'); ዘተናገረ 'which spoke, that speaks' (a relative clause qualifying ልሳን 'tongue'). The speech returns to wisdom as the condition of kingship, which is the theme that carries the whole chapter.

sentences.t: ጥበብሰ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኴሉ ፡ መዛግብት ፤
sentences.l: wisdom-as-for she-is-better than all treasuries;
sentences.i: Wisdom is better than all treasuries;
sentences.n: Same construction as ጥበብሰ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ above: the claim of the opening is repeated as a refrain, now with ኴሉ መዛግብት 'all treasuries' (መዛግብት, plural of መዝገብ 'treasure, store').

sentences.t: ዘዘገበ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ወብሩረ ፡ ኢይበቈዕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥበብ ፤
sentences.l: he-who-stored gold and-silver not-he-profits without wisdom;
sentences.i: he who has stored up gold and silver does not prosper without wisdom;
sentences.n: ዘዘገበ 'he who stored up' (ዘ- + 3ms perfect of ዘገበ 'heap up, store'; the root is also the source of መዝገብ and መዛግብት above, which is how I take it, though I have not checked the verb in a lexicon (?)). ኢይበቈዕ 'he does not profit, does not thrive' (በቍዐ 'be of use, profit').

sentences.t: ወዘዘገበ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘየሀይዶ ፡ እምነ ፡ ልቡ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-who-stored wisdom there-is-not (one) who-removes-him from heart-his;
sentences.i: but he who has stored up wisdom, there is none who removes it from his heart;
sentences.n: ወዘዘገበ ጥበበ 'and he who stored up wisdom' (ዘ- relative before the perfect). አልቦ 'there is not' (negative existential). ዘየሀይዶ 'who drives him away' (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ሀየደ 'drive away, put to flight' + -ዶ, a 3ms object suffix); the suffix may mean 'him' or 'it' (wisdom), so the sentence can mean 'none can drive wisdom from his heart' or 'none can drive him from his heart's desire'. I take the first. The -ወ- of the line is the ወ- 'but' contrasting with the previous.

sentences.t: ወዘዘገኩ ፡ አብዳን ፡ ይበልዑ ፡ ጠቢባን ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለዐማፅያን ፡ ይትዌደሱ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ስሐተቶሙ ፡ ለአብዳን ፡ ይትፈቀሩ ፡ ጠቢባን ።
sentences.l: and-what-[stored?] fools they-eat wise-men, and-on-account-of evil-their of-the-wicked they-are-praised righteous-men, and-on-account-of error-their of-fools they-are-loved wise-men.
sentences.i: What fools have stored up, the wise eat; for the evil of the wicked the righteous are praised, and for the folly of fools the wise are loved.
sentences.n: ወዘዘገኩ አብዳን 'and what the fools stored': ዘዘገኩ looks like ዘ- + a form of ዘገበ, but ዘገኩ (a 1cs ending) cannot be right after 'fools'; I read it as a corrupt or variant form of ዘዘገቡ (3mp) and mark it uncertain (?). The saying that the wise inherit what fools gather echoes Proverbs 13:22 and Ecclesiastes 2:26. ይበልዑ 'they eat' (3mp imperfect of በልዐ). ጠቢባን, ጻድቃን, አብዳን, ዐማፅያን are plural nouns used as persons (the broken plurals of ጠቢብ, ጻዲቅ, አብድ, ዐማፂ). ወበእንተ 'and on account of'; እከዮሙ ለዐማፅያን 'their evil, of the wicked' (the suffix -ሙ anticipates the possessor named with ለ-, the pattern flagged in ch. 21–23). ይትዌደሱ 'they are praised' (ተወድሰ, passive of ወደሰ), ይትፈቀሩ 'they are loved' (passive of ፈቀረ); the verbs mean that the wise and righteous are exalted by contrast with the folly around them. ስሐተት 'error, fault'.

sentences.t: ጥበብሰ ፡ ልዕልት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወብዕልት ፡ አነ ፡ ኣፈቅራ ፡ ከመ ፡ እም ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ተሐቅፈኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሕፃና ፡ አነ ፡ እተሉ ፡ አሠራ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ተዐቅበኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ አነ ፡ አኀሥሣ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ትከውነኒ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ፡ እተሉ ፡ አሠራ ፡ ወኢይትገደፍ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ኣሰምክ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ወትከውነኒ ፡ ጥቅመ ፡ አድማስ ፡ እጸወን ፡ ባቲ ፡ ወትከውነኒ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ወጽንዐ ፡ እትፌሣሕ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ወትከውነኒ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ ብዙኀ ።
sentences.l: wisdom-as-for exalted she and-rich; I I-love-her as mother, and-she embraces-me as child; I I-follow tracks-of-her to-wisdom, and-she guards-me until for-ever; I I-seek her to-wisdom, and-she will-be-to-me for-[zəluf?]; I-follow tracks-her, and-not-is-cast-away from-her; I-lean on-her, and-she-will-be-to-me [ṭəqmä] of-ends; I-find-protection in-her, and-she-will-be-to-me strength and-might; I-rejoice in-her, and-she-will-be-to-me grace much.
sentences.i: Wisdom is exalted and rich. I love her as a mother, and she embraces me as a child. I follow the tracks of wisdom, and she guards me for ever. I seek wisdom, and she will be mine for good (?). I follow her tracks, and he is not cast away from her. I lean on her, and she will be for me a [ṭəqm] (?) of the world's ends; I find protection in her, and she will be my strength and power; I rejoice in her, and she will be for me abundant grace.
sentences.n: The longest unit of the chapter, kept whole because it has no ፤ to cut at. It is a chain of paired clauses of the form 'I do X to her — and she does Y to me'. ልዕልት and ብዕልት are the feminine adjectives 'exalted' and 'rich'; ይእቲ 'she'; አነ ኣፈቅራ 'I love her' (አነ + 1cs imperfect with -ኣ 'her'). The imperfects ተሐቅፈኒ 'she embraces me' and ተዐቅበኒ 'she guards me' are 3fs forms spelled with ተ- (the expected form is ት-), with -ኒ 'me'. ከመ 'as, like'. እተሉ አሠራ 'I follow her tracks' (ተለወ 'follow'; አሠር 'footprint, track'), with ለጥበብ naming the 'her'. ለዝሉፉ: I cannot identify ዝሉፉ; it looks related to ዘልፈ 'continually' and I give 'for good' with a query (?). ኢይትገደፍ 'is not cast away' (ተገድፈ, passive of ገደፈ 'cast off'), subject unclear. ኣሰምክ ባቲ 'I lean on her' (my reading of ሰምከ 'lean, rest', uncertain (?)); ጥቅመ አድማስ 'a [ṭəqmä] of the ends (አድማስ) of the earth': ጥቅመ is unidentified and I leave it bracketed (?). እጸወን ባቲ 'I find protection in her' (my reading of ጸወነ 'shelter, protect', uncertain (?)). ኀይለ ወጽንዐ 'strength and might' (accusatives); እትፌሣሕ ባቲ 'I rejoice in her' (1cs imperfect of ተፈሥሐ); ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace' (ሞገስ 'grace, favour'). The whole is the sage's pledge in Proverbs 4:6–9 and 8:17: 'I love those who love me'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ንትሉ ፡ አሠራ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ወይልካእ ፡ ሰኰናነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መድረከ ፡ ኆኃቲሃ ፡ ለጥበብ ፤
sentences.l: for right (that) we-follow tracks-of wisdom, and-he-wears-down soles at threshold-of doors-her of-wisdom;
sentences.i: for it is right that we follow the tracks of wisdom, and that one wear down his soles at the threshold of wisdom's doors;
sentences.n: እስመ ርቱዕ 'for it is right' (ርቱዕ 'right, fitting', an adjective used as a predicate), then ንትሉ 'that we follow' (1cp subjunctive). ይልካእ ሰኰናነ: I read ይልካእ as 3ms jussive 'let him wear out' and ሰኰናነ as the accusative of ሰኰና 'sole, hoof'; the verb is not one I can confirm (?). The picture of wearing down the threshold of wisdom's doors recalls Proverbs 8:34 ('watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors') and Ben Sira 6:36. መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'threshold-of her doors' (construct chain; ኆኃቲሃ 'her doors', a plural of ኆኅት 'door' with -ሃ 'her'), then ለጥበብ naming the 'her', the usual anticipation.

sentences.t: ንኅሥሣ ፡ ወንረክባ ፡ ናፍቅራ ፡ ወኢትርሕቅ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ንዴግና ፡ ወንረክባ ፡ ንስአላ ፡ ወንነሥኣ ፤
sentences.l: let-us-seek-her and-let-us-find-her; let-us-love-her and-not-she-will-be-far from-us; let-us-follow-her and-let-us-find-her; let-us-ask-her and-let-us-take-her;
sentences.i: Let us seek her and find her; let us love her and she will not be far from us; let us follow her and find her; let us ask her and receive her;
sentences.n: First-person plural jussives with ን- and -ኣ 'her': ንኅሥሣ 'let us seek her', ንረክባ 'let us find her' (ረከበ), ናፍቅራ 'let us love her' (አፍቀረ), ንዴግና 'let us follow her' (ደገነ), ንስአላ 'let us ask her', ንነሥኣ 'let us take her'. ኢትርሕቅ 'she will not be far' (3fs). The thought is that of Wisdom of Solomon 6:12–16 ('she is easily seen by those who love her and found by those who seek her') and Matthew 7:7 ('ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find'); I name them as echoes only.

sentences.t: ንሚጥ ፡ ልበነ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንርስዓ ፡ በኴሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ እስመ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ዘከርዋ ፡ ትዜክር ፡ ለሊሃ ፤
sentences.l: let-us-incline heart-our to-her that-not-we-forget-her at-all time, for if they-remember-her she-remembers herself;
sentences.i: Let us turn our heart to her, so that we never forget her; for if they remember her, she herself remembers.
sentences.n: ንሚጥ ልበነ 'let us turn our heart' (1cp jussive of ሜጠ 'turn'; ልበነ 'our heart'). ከመ ኢንርስዓ 'so that we not forget her' (ረሰዐ). በኴሉ ጊዜ 'at every time'. ለእመ 'if' (a conditional). ዘከርዋ 'they remember her' (3mp perfect + -ዋ); ትዜክር 'she remembers' (3fs imperfect of ዘከረ, with the ዜ spelling), ለሊሃ 'she herself'. The thought is that wisdom answers those who remember her.

sentences.t: ወበኀበ ፡ አብዳንሰ ፡ ኢትዘክር ፡ ጥበበ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያከብርዋ ፡ ወኢታፈቅሮሙ ።
sentences.l: and-with fools-as-for not-she-remembers wisdom, for not-they-honour-her and-not-she-loves-them.
sentences.i: But among fools wisdom does not remember them, for they do not honour her and she does not love them.
sentences.n: ወበኀበ አብዳንሰ 'and among the fools, as for them' (ኀበ 'with, among', here with the contrastive -ሰ). ኢትዘክር ጥበበ: the subject seems to be wisdom, since ኢታፈቅሮሙ 'she does not love them' follows, so I read ጥበበ as a nominative spelled with -ε, but it could instead be the object of a 2ms verb ('you do not remember wisdom') (?). ኢያከብርዋ 'they do not honour her' (አክበረ + -ዋ).

sentences.t: ወክብራሰ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ አክብሮ ፡ ጠቢብ ፡ ወፍቅራኒ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ አፍቅሮቱ ፡ ለጠቢብ ፤
sentences.l: and-honour-as-for of-wisdom (is) honouring-of wise, and-love-also of-wisdom (is) loving-of the-wise;
sentences.i: For to honour wisdom is to honour the wise man, and to love wisdom is to love the wise man;
sentences.n: ወክብራሰ ለጥበብ 'and as for the honour of wisdom' (ክብር + -ሰ, with the possessor given by ለጥበብ). አክብሮ and አፍቅሮቱ are infinitives ('honouring', 'loving'), the second of the form አፍቅሮት; each is followed by the object in the construct. ጠቢብ 'wise man'. The claim is that honouring wisdom means honouring those who have it, which prepares for the queen's own journey.

sentences.t: አፍቅሮ ፡ ለጠቢብ ፡ ወኢትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ወበራእየ ፡ ዚዓሁ ፡ ትከውን ፡ ጠቢብ ፤
sentences.l: love-of the-wise and-not-be-far from-him, and-in-seeing-of his-own-self you-will-be wise;
sentences.i: love the wise man and do not go far from him, and by the sight of him you will be wise;
sentences.n: Now addressed to one person: አፍቅሮ 'love him' (taken as a 2ms imperative, with the ለጠቢብ phrase), ኢትርሐቅ 'do not be far' (2ms jussive). በራእየ ዚዓሁ 'by the seeing of his own self' (ራእይ 'sight' in construct; ዚዓሁ is a spelling of ዚአሁ 'his, his own'); ትከውን ጠቢብ 'you will be wise'. The thought is that of Proverbs 13:20, 'he who walks with the wise will be wise'.

sentences.t: ስማዕ ፡ መክሥተ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኩን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ወርኢ ፡ መከይደ ፡ እገሪሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታንብር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኬደ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወኢትሰስል ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትንሣእ ፡ ተረፋተ ፡ ጥበቡ ።
sentences.l: hear opening-of his-mouth that you-be like-him, and-see tread-of his-feet that you-set where he-walked he, and-not-slacken from-him that you-take remains-of his-wisdom.
sentences.i: Listen to what his mouth discloses, that you may be like him; and watch the tread of his feet, that you may set your foot where he has walked; and do not hold back from him, that you may take the remnants of his wisdom.
sentences.n: A run of imperatives and ከመ 'that' clauses. ስማዕ 'hear' (2ms imperative of ሰምዐ); መክሥተ አፉሁ 'the opening of his mouth' (መክሥት 'disclosure, opening', in the construct; አፉሁ 'his mouth', where አፍ takes the stem አፉ- before a suffix). ትኩን 'that you be' (2ms jussive of ኮነ). ርኢ 'see' (imperative of ርእየ); መከይደ እገሪሁ 'the tread of his feet' (መከይድ is a noun from ከይደ 'walk'; the exact sense is uncertain (?); እገሪሁ 'his feet'). ታንብር 'that you set' (አንበረ 'place'), with no object stated; I supply 'your foot'. ኀበ ኬደ ውእቱ 'where he walked'. ኢትሰስል 'do not slacken, hold back' (ሰሰለ; my reading, uncertain (?)). ተረፋተ ጥበቡ 'the remnants of his wisdom' (ተረፍ 'remainder', plural ተረፋት, accusative; ጥበቡ 'his wisdom'). Here the praise becomes personal: the queen pictures herself as the disciple of the wise king, which is the logic of the journey.

sentences.t: ወአንሰ ፡ በሰሚዕኒ ፡ አፍቀርክዎ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እርአዮ ፤
sentences.l: and-I-as-for in-hearing-also I-loved-him without I-see-him;
sentences.i: And I, by hearing alone, loved him without seeing him;
sentences.n: ወአንሰ 'and as for me'. በሰሚዕኒ 'in hearing' (በ- + the infinitive ሰሚዕ 'hearing' + -ኒ, which I take as the enclitic 'indeed, even', giving 'by hearing alone'; it could instead be a 1cs suffix (?)). አፍቀርክዎ 'I loved him' (1cs perfect of አፍቀረ + -ዎ 'him'). ዘእንበለ እርአዮ 'without my seeing him' (ዘእንበለ + a 1cs subjunctive, እርአዮ 'that I see him'). Compare 1 Peter 1:8, 'whom, not having seen, you love'; the queen's love is by report, as in 1 Kings 10:6–7, where she says that she believed not the words until she came.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኴሉ ፡ ዜና ፡ ነገሩ ፡ በኀቤየ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ፍትወ ፡ ለልብየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ለጽሙእ ፨
sentences.l: for all report-of his-speech with-me became desire for-heart-my, like water for-the-thirsty. ፨
sentences.i: For every report of his words became a longing to my heart, like water to the thirsty.
sentences.n: ኴሉ ዜና ነገሩ 'every account of his speech' (ዜና 'report, news'; ነገሩ 'his matter, word'). በኀቤየ 'with me, in my case' (በ- + ኀበ 'with' + -የ). ኮነ 'became'. ፍትወ ለልብየ 'a longing for my heart' (ፍትወት 'desire', the accusative form ፍትወ). ከመ ማይ ለጽሙእ 'like water for the thirsty' (ጽሙእ 'thirsty'). The ፨ closes the queen's speech.

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤልዋ ፡ መኳንንቲሃ ፡ ወአግብርቲሃ ፡ ወአእማቲሃ ፡ ወመማክርቲሃ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ጥበብሰ ፡ ኢተኀጥአ ፡ እምኔኪ ፡ ወበጥበብኪ ፡ ዘታፈቅሪ ፡ ጥበበ ፤
sentences.l: They-answered and-said-to-her, her-nobles and-her-servants and-her-maidservants and-her-counsellors: our-lady, wisdom-as-for not-has-failed from-you, and-in-wisdom-your which-you-love wisdom;
sentences.i: Her nobles, her servants, her maidservants and her counsellors answered and said to her: 'Our lady, wisdom has not failed you, and in your wisdom you love wisdom;
sentences.n: አውሥኡ ወይቤልዋ 'they answered and said to her' (3mp perfects; አውሥአ 'answer', ይቤ 'he said' with -ልዋ 'to her'), with the subjects after the verbs: መኳንንቲሃ 'her nobles', አግብርቲሃ 'her servants', አእማቲሃ 'her maidservants' (plural of አመት), መማክርቲሃ 'her counsellors', all with -ሃ 'her'. እግዝእትነ 'our lady'. ኢተኀጥአ 'has not failed, been lacking' (ተኀጥአ, from ኀጥአ 'miss, fail'; uncertain (?)); እምኔኪ 'from you' (2fs). ወበጥበብኪ ዘታፈቅሪ ጥበበ 'and in your wisdom, you love wisdom': ዘታፈቅሪ is ዘ- + a 2fs imperfect of አፍቀረ ('you love'); the construction is odd and I give the sense (?).

sentences.t: ወንሕነሰ ፡ እመኒ ፡ ሖርኪ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ ነበርኪ ፡ ንነብር ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ወትኩን ፡ ሞትነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሞትኪ ፡ ወሕይወትነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕይወትኪ ፨
sentences.l: and-we-as-for if-indeed you-go we-go with-you, and-if-indeed you-stay we-stay with-you; and-let-be death-our with death-your and-life-our with life-your. ፨
sentences.i: And as for us, if you go we will go with you, and if you stay we will stay with you; and may our death be with your death and our life with your life.'
sentences.n: ወንሕነሰ 'and as for us' (ንሕነ 'we' + -ሰ). እመኒ 'if even, whether' (እመ 'if' + -ኒ), repeated twice as 'if … and if …'. ሖርኪ 'you went' (2fs perfect, used for 'if you go'); ነሐውር 'we will go' (1cp imperfect); ነበርኪ 'you stayed' (2fs perfect); ንነብር 'we will stay'. ምስሌኪ 'with you' (ምስለ + -ኪ 'you', 2fs). ትኩን 'let it be' (3fs jussive). The pledge is the vow of Ruth to Naomi (Ruth 1:16–17) in a Geʿez setting, and the pairing 'death with death, life with life' is its sharpest part. The ፨ ends the courtiers' answer.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ተደለወት ፡ ለሐዊር ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ክብር ፡ ወግርማ ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ ሥንቅ ፡ ወተድላ ፤
sentences.l: and-then she-made-ready to-go with-much glory and-majesty, with-great provision and-delight;
sentences.i: Then she made ready to go with great honour and majesty, with ample provisions and comfort;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then' (እምዝ 'after this'). ተደለወት 'she made ready' (as in the heading). በብዙኅ ክብር 'with much glory' (adjective before the noun); ወግርማ 'and majesty' (ግርማ 'awe, majesty'); በዐቢይ ሥንቅ 'with great provision' (ሥንቅ 'provisions for a journey'); ወተድላ 'and delight, ease'. The royal style of travel is laid out, with the equipment of ch. 23 now ready.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ፈተወ ፡ ልባ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስማዕ ፡ ጥበቢሁ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፤
sentences.l: for her-heart-wished by-will-of God that she-go Jerusalem, that she-hear wisdom-his of-Solomon;
sentences.i: for her heart desired, by the will of God, to go to Jerusalem and hear the wisdom of Solomon;
sentences.n: ፈተወ ልባ 'her heart wished' (ልብ + -ኣ 'her'). በፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the will of God' (construct: ፈቃድ 'will' + እግዚኣብሔር). The theology is that of the end of ch. 23: the journey is also God's doing. ከመ ትሖር 'that she go' (3fs jussive of ሖረ); ኢየሩሳሌም 'Jerusalem', with no preposition (an accusative of goal); ከመ ትስማዕ 'that she hear' (3fs subjunctive); ጥበቢሁ ለሰሎሞን 'his wisdom, Solomon's' (the suffix anticipates the name, as flagged earlier). This follows 1 Kings 10:1 and 2 Chronicles 9:1, where she hears of Solomon's fame and comes to test him.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ሰምዐት ፡ ወጽህቀት ።
sentences.l: for she-heard and-[ṣəḥqät?].
sentences.i: for she had heard and [was moved] (?).
sentences.n: ሰምዐት 'she heard' (3fs perfect of ሰምዐ). ጽህቀት is unidentified: it reads as a 3fs perfect of a root ጽሕቀ (ṣ-ḥ-q) that I cannot place, so I leave it bracketed and give 'was moved' only as a guess from context, the clause being short and its object unstated (?).

sentences.t: ተደለወት ፡ ለሐዊር ፤
sentences.l: She-made-ready to-go;
sentences.i: She made ready to go;
sentences.n: A resumptive sentence: ተደለወት ለሐዊር repeats the heading's words, as the narrator returns to the action after the short reason given above.

sentences.t: ወተጽዕነ ፡ ራኩብ ፡ ፯፻ወ፺ ፡ ወ፯ ፡ ወበቅልሰ ፡ ወዓድግ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ኆልቈ ፡ ተጽዕነ ፤
sentences.l: and-were-loaded [rakub] 797, and-mules and-asses which not-with-them number, were-loaded;
sentences.i: and 797 pack-animals (?) were loaded, and mules and asses without number were loaded;
sentences.n: ተጽዕነ 'was loaded' (3ms perfect of ተጽዕነ, the passive of 'load'; I have not checked the stem); the verb stands before its plural subject and is repeated at the end. ራኩብ I read as a beast of burden, perhaps a camel, from the root of 'ride, mount', but I cannot confirm it, so it is bracketed in the literal line and queried in the free one (?). The number ፯፻ወ፺ ፡ ወ፯ is 700 + 90 + 7 = 797, kept as printed with its ወ- 'and' riders; the spoken Geʿez words are for the glosser. በቅልስ 'mules' and ዓድግ 'asses' (ዐድግ), both collectives; ወበቅልሰ is the accusative form. ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'which have no number' (ዘ- + አልቦ + ኆልቍ 'count').

sentences.t: ወሖረት ፡ ወዓርትዐት ፡ ፍኖታ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትዌከል ፡ ልባበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-she-went and-she-set-straight way-her while he-trusts in-understanding-of God. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And she set out and made straight her road, trusting in the understanding of God.
sentences.n: ወሖረት 'and she went' (3fs perfect of ሖረ). ወዓርትዐት ፍኖታ 'and she set her road straight' (3fs perfect of አርትዐ 'make straight, put right', here spelled ዓርትዐ; ፍኖት 'road' + -ኣ 'her'). እንዘ ይትዌከል 'while he trusts' (እንዘ 'while' + imperfect of ተወከለ 'rely, trust'): the verb is written with a 3ms ይ- although the subject is the queen, so it is probably a slip for ት-, or an impersonal use (?). ልባበ እግዚኣብሔር: I read ልባበ as ልባቤ 'understanding, counsel', in the accusative, so 'the counsel of God' (uncertain (?)). The row of ፨ closes the chapter and the part.
